== Players Committee forum (forum.starwarsccg.org) facts added, 24 November 2026 ==
New page from the live Players Committee forum. Sources used: topic 10070 (posts 138643, 139222, 139292, 140374, 140535, 140611, 140687, 140704, 140708, 140709, 141246, 142423, 143141).
=== Missing data ===
* The tournament director's surname: he posted as Spencer_00_us and signed "Spencer". (His contact address is left out under the no-personal-email rule.)
* Official standings and decklists: Spencer promised them on 15 June 2006, but they are not in the topic.
* Whether a "Most Creative Out of This World Deck" prize was awarded.
=== Left out ===
* The list of six singles from the TD's collection (BB Premiere Darth Vader, Reflections I foil Ben Kenobi, Tatooine Darth Maul and Sebulba, Reflections III Thok & Thug, Cloud City Captain Han Solo), phone numbers, e-mail addresses and the event website address (not archived).
* The argument in posts 142492–142737 (Jim Jerriko, jimli, bluethrawn) and the details of PapaLorax's appeal quoted in Carr's post; only the outcome is used.
=== Possibly faulty data ===
* The results come second-hand: Crazy Hermit did not attend and reported what others told him. PapaLorax (Evan Fitzgerald), quoted by Carr, wrote that reports should have said "Jim Li concede the final - Jim Beyer is WI States Champ"; Carr's ruling made Li the champion.
